steps.title: Establish owned isolated fixture
preconditions: Real automation-enabled Catalyst app on authorized macOS; new synthetic process-owned persistent root. No private capability files, tokens, journal injection, production data or native accessibility helper.
Run ordered entire journey through tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/capability-safety. Public ScrivSession manages IDs and retained descriptors. No command retries after timeout.

Read-only waitFor polls snapshots at 50ms up to 15s; saved-project poll at 75ms up to 15s retries only initial-publication-pending. Shared reveal resolves one control, requires enabled+hittable, and may scroll its reachable ancestor at most eight times. Project opening uses public activate, text search and Open project activation.

Full source context and helpers are pinned in capability-safety-manifest.json. This prepared witness needs independent semantic review and matching native execution; status advertisement alone does not prove transport/credential safety.
actions: ScrivSession.launch(app,{persistent:true}); capabilities verifies protocol, driver, isolation object, workspace flags, UUID identities, root suffix, unique command list and declared supported/absent commands.
Select Script; key command-s; wait for saved YAM MAN sentinel. import-json exact one-direction fixture from witness lines 55-61; read persisted-projects and loaded-project.
Compare every fixture field, allowing only generated UUID and finite createdAt/modifiedAt; packages exactly [sample,current], loaded project exact, presented-alerts empty.

expectations.description: Fresh persistent capability contract has expected identities and advertised policy, and saved fixture matches independent input.
Independent fixture and unchanged package/model/alert invariants.

preconditions: Real automation-enabled Catalyst app on authorized macOS; new synthetic process-owned persistent root. No private capability files, tokens, journal injection, production data or native accessibility helper.
Run ordered entire journey through tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/capability-safety. Public ScrivSession manages IDs and retained descriptors. No command retries after timeout.

Read-only waitFor polls snapshots at 50ms up to 15s; saved-project poll at 75ms up to 15s retries only initial-publication-pending. Shared reveal resolves one control, requires enabled+hittable, and may scroll its reachable ancestor at most eight times. Full source context and helpers are pinned in capability-safety-manifest.json. This prepared witness needs independent semantic review and matching native execution; status advertisement alone does not prove transport/credential safety.
The first step saved sample and independent fixture; expectedLoaded is full read-only loaded-project response. Script tab is active and workspace-tabs is unique, enabled and hittable.
actions: For install-token, authorize-origin, outbox-write, resume, reset and delete-workspace send target workspace-tabs and require exact Unknown command response. These are deliberately unsupported commands, not credential/network/outbox calls.
After EACH refusal compare entire sorted packages, full loaded-project including dates, and presented-alerts=[].
Reject activate without target and with absent target; select indices -1, segment count and string 0; text on noneditor workspace-tabs; key without modifiers. Require each exact error and invariant.
Reject extra path parameter on loaded-project, local-image-evidence, script-interaction-counts and presented-alerts; exact error and invariant after each.
import-json valid current project JSON padded to exactly 65,537 ASCII bytes (under 1 MiB transport); assert JSON parses identically, exact refusal and full unchanged invariant.
Reject relaunch({root:session.root}); require full capabilities unchanged, package/model/alert invariant and same selected tab.

expectations.description: Every invalid public request receives exact error followed by full nonmutation assertions.

expectations.description: Two process rotations preserve root/run and exact saved/loaded document while old sessions refuse use.

mappings.why: Both real persistent process rotations duplicate the inherited owned descriptor and close the original inherited descriptor before opening other files. The public capabilities and cold-open model assertions depend on this admitted resume path; failure cleanup is not claimed. Static association only; native execution is recorded separately. Guard-failure, tamper, contention and unobserved OS metadata/security properties are excluded.

Preparation opens the resolved temporary parent, checks the successful open, arranges its close and selects the resumed branch. The two public rotations rely on this parent setup. The following fstat/privateDirectory/childMatches checks are outside this exact range and are not attributed to it. Static association only; native execution is recorded separately. Guard-failure, tamper, contention and unobserved OS metadata/security properties are excluded.
